events.verdict: Following the initial pick, Camara (POR) places his off-arm against Westbrook (DEN) to position himself to receive the pass. The contact is marginal and does not prevent Westbrook from defending the play.
Westbrook (DEN) cleanly blocks Simons' (POR) driving shot attempt.
Simons (POR) places both hands on Murray (DEN) with slight extension as he releases away to receive the throw-in.

Jokic (DEN) moves laterally into Simons (POR) and initiates body contact that affects his SQBR during the drive. The illegal contact occurs just before Simons gathers the ball and a non-shooting foul is correctly called.

Replay review of the foul called on Jokic (DEN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Jokic extends his arms into Sharpe (POR), dislodging him from his rebounding position and there is no illegal contact by Camara (POR) during the play.
Avdija (POR) briefly places both hands on Jokic's (DEN) back as he receives the pass but the contact is marginal.
Avdija (POR) is retracting his arm into a vertical position and the ensuing contact with Jokic's (DEN) arm is marginal.
Westbrook (DEN) reaches in and avoids making any illegal contact with Simons (POR) during his driving shot attempt.
